title: Ghost Lap
description: Race a neon circuit that never repeats. Every lap you finish becomes a ghost that keeps driving your exact line forever. Touch one and you crash, so find new gaps, graze ghosts for combo points and survive one more lap.
instructions: Your car accelerates by itself. Hold the left or right half of the screen (or Left/Right arrows, A/D) to steer. Stay on the track (3 wall hits ends the run), never touch a ghost, and skim past them for near-miss combos. M toggles sound.
